task: PHASE 6: PREMIUM GAMEPLAY FEEL, FAIRNESS AND COLLISION INTEGRITY
acceptance_criteria: STEP 1: Gameplay baseline and defect reproduction for lane changes, jumps, slides, moving trains, rooftop ramps, death/restart, and camera recovery.
STEP 2: Establish collision authority between visual geometry, collision shapes, and support surfaces across obstacle types, player speeds, and action states.
STEP 3: Human-scale route fairness validating reaction time, warning distance, visibility, action cooldowns, and solvability.
STEP 4: Premium movement feel verifying lane acceleration, animation-motion sync, landing anticipation, fast drop, and camera damping without sacrificing input responsiveness.
STEP 5: Protect gameplay after death: full stop, no vibration, no repeated death triggers, clean power-up reset, no event director leaks, clean restart/revive.
STEP 6: Controlled risk/reward gameplay: readable rooftop approaches, high-risk coin paths, branching options without making high-risk routes mandatory.
STEP 7: Verification release gate: full build, worldgen, train gaps, rooftop regression, browser tests with collision ENABLED, before/after evidence.
